entities.description: Homer sees three Black migrant workers showering in a wooden stall that partially exposes them, with a fourth man running behind the cider house while wrapping a towel around himself after showering.

entities.description: Jack complains that the hot water has been used up, while Muddy accuses him of using his soap, leading to a brief verbal exchange about the scarcity of hot water and hygiene supplies.

entities.description: Wally leans close to Homer and advises him that the key to dealing with Mr. Rose is to allow him to feel in control, leaving Homer momentarily puzzled.

document_metadata.summary: Homer talks with Candy about feeling bored and her loneliness; she invites him to see a lobster, then he runs to catch the departing tractor as they part ways, with Candy inviting him back next week.
